{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 内嵌 VSCode 编辑器插件：嵌入完整 code-server，agent 写文件时自动弹出红绿 diff 跟随（edit sync / file locking / follow mode）","id":"gh:1346222428","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-vsceditor","slug":"k-ying/dsh-vsceditor","topics":["code-server","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","editor","vscode"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 内嵌 VSCode 编辑器插件：嵌入完整 code-server，agent 写文件时自动弹出红绿 diff 跟随（edit sync / file locking "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ss 内嵌 VSCode 编辑器插件：嵌入完整 code-server，agent 写文件时自动弹出红绿 diff 跟随（edit sync / file locking / follow mode）"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-vsceditor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**An embedded VS Code editor plugin for DeepSeek Harness** — embeds a full code-server (complete VS "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"Code) inside the DSH web UI. Every time the agent writes or edits a file, the editor pops a red/gree"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"n diff and jumps to the first changed line — you literally watch the AI work."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 1. Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Three mutually exclusive backends: embedded / local / off** — embedded code-server by default; s"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"witch to **local VS Code** to move follow/diff/locking into your own desktop editor; or switch to **"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"Off** to disconnect everything (the watchdog kills the whole code-server tree, the local extension u"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"nlinks, and the resident iframe's renderer memory is released). The power button in the editor toolb"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ar operates the same setting and doubles as a one-click way back on
- **Real VS Code, not a toy edit"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"or** — the embedded one is code-server 4.x (full VS Code kernel): extensions, themes, keybindings an"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"d the Git panel all work
- **Follow mode, turn-scoped diffs** — when the agent calls `write`/`edit`,"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" the editor opens a red/green diff view of that file and scrolls to the first changed line; DSH also"},{"id":"p6s9","text":" renders its own read-only diff tab, so you can watch either side. Diffs accumulate per file for a w"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"hole conversation turn, survive tab closes and editor reloads, and are cleared only when the next tu"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"rn starts editing (see 5.3)
- **File locking** — while the agent is writing a file it becomes read-o"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"nly in the editor (prevents you and the AI overwriting each other); it unlocks automatically when th"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"e write finishes
- **No orphaned processes** — code-server runs under a watchdog that heartbeats the"},{"id":"p6s14","text":" DSH host and kills the whole editor process tree when the host dies (crash / force-quit / Studio up"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"grade); a reaper also sweeps historical leftovers at startup and every 30 min. Your own desktop VS C"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"ode and self-installed code-server are never touched
- **Workspace follows the session** — one DSH p"},{"id":"p6s17","text":"rocess runs one code-server; when the active session's workspace changes, the editor switches to tha"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"t directory (restarting code-server when needed)
- **Persistent iframe** — the editor page stays att"},{"id":"p6s19","text":"ached to `<body>`; switching tabs only hides/shows it instead of starting a new VS Code session ever"},{"id":"p6s20","text":"y click
- **Settings page integration** — a collapsible card under Settings → Plugins → Plugin Confi"},{"id":"p6s21","text":"guration: follow toggle, auto-start, port, code-server home. Everything applies live and persists (`"},{"id":"p6s22","text":"~/.dsh/settings.yaml`)
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 2. How it works"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Message semantics follow ACP `session/update`: `edit {path, oldText, newText, firstLine}` is pushed "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"by the host with computed diff stats; the extension renders it. The host mounts unscoped, so it sees"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" tool events from all sessions (scoped events flow up the scope chain)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 3. Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web profile (this plugin is a profile bundle mounted on the host plane)
- d"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"sh **0.1.0-rc.1 – 0.2.x**: `engines.dsh` declares this range (and `peerDependencies` keeps the same "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"lines for consumers that read peers), and dsh compares it against the **running** runtime version — "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"a plugin outside the range is refused outright at install time. The 0.2.x line was checked against *"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"*0.2.1-alpha.1** (the build the Tauri desktop shell ships) and **0.2.2-rc.1**: host services, events"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" and argument shapes all match
- macOS, Linux or Windows — **local VS Code mode is verified on Windo"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ws** (2026-09-23, Windows 10 Pro 22H2 + VS Code 1.138.0, all three of #4/#5/#6 passed; report: `docs"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"/windows-verification-report.md`). The **code-server backend on Windows is experimental** — code-ser"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ver publishes no official Windows build (see 4.2 → Windows)
- **Embedded mode**: a code-server insta"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"llation (see 4.2); **local VS Code mode**: desktop VS Code. You need at least one of the two — **the"},{"id":"p11s11","text":" plugin works without code-server, but only in local VS Code mode**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 4. Installation"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 4.1 Install the plugin"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Option A: from GitHub (recommended)**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 4.2 Install code-server (required for embedded mode)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 8. Security notes"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Control-plane routes are fenced** (`/state`, `/action`): the Host must be loopback, the address "},{"id":"p20s2","text":"the request actually arrived on, or a host you declared in **Trusted hosts**; `sec-fetch-site: cross"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"-site` is rejected; `Origin` must match `Host` when present; and state-changing POSTs must carry an "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"`Origin` at all (browsers always send one, blind local scripts do not). `set-config` additionally ac"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"cepts only known config keys
- **A non-loopback socket may only speak for a declared trusted host.**"},{"id":"p20s6","text":" Outside a browser, `Host` and `Origin` are both forgeable — the socket address is the only honest s"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ignal — so without that rule a local process (or a LAN peer on a LAN-bound DSH) could simply claim `"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"Host: 127.0.0.1` and drive the control plane. Same-machine access through your machine's own LAN add"},{"id":"p20s9","text":"ress or hostname still works, because the loopback socket proves the client is local
- **Reaching DS"},{"id":"p20s10","text":"H through a reverse proxy / custom domain / Tailscale MagicDNS / ngrok?** Declare that hostname in *"},{"id":"p20s11","text":"*Trusted hosts** (Settings → Plugin config), in the plugin row's `config:`, or directly in the `dsh-"},{"id":"p20s12","text":"vsceditor` section of `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`. Until it is declared the control routes answer 403 and"},{"id":"p20s13","text":" the Editor tab reports the bridge as unmounted — and the settings card cannot save in that state ei"},{"id":"p20s14","text":"ther, so edit the file. The plugin also inherits DSH's own `trustedHosts` (the `connection` service)"},{"id":"p20s15","text":", so a host already declared for the deployment does not need declaring twice
- **A settings save or"},{"id":"p20s16","text":" a toolbar button appears to do nothing?** Fenced writes used to fail silently. They now surface as "},{"id":"p20s17","text":"a red line in the panel (an HTTP 403 names the fence and points at **Trusted hosts**), and the exten"},{"id":"p20s18","text":"sion's most recent ack — `kind`, `opened`, `timeout`, `error` — is exposed as `lastAck` on `GET /__d"},{"id":"p20s19","text":"sh-vsceditor/state`. `opened: false, timeout: true` means VS Code did not confirm the diff within 6s"},{"id":"p20s20","text":"; `edit-error` means it threw, and the panel shows the reason too. `bridgeDebug` turns on the extens"},{"id":"p20s21","text":"ion's own trace (`/tmp/dsh-bridge-debug.log`) when you need to go deeper
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
